remarks: Welcome to the beautiful Wolfpit area of Norwalk! SPACIOUS & UPDATED first floor three bedroom apartment on cute and quiet street. Conveniently located minutes from highways, restaurants, mall, beach and MORE. Walk to Stew Leonard's! Washer/Dryer on main level! PET FRIENDLY (CASE BY CASE BASIS)! LISTING PRICE INCLUDES STORAGE + 2 ASSIGNED PARKING IN DRIVEWAY. NATURAL GAS heat/hot water keep the utilities LOW. Sit back and RELAX and enjoy a nice warm drink on your own private front porch facing Roscoe. Walk into unit and flows comfortably from open living room, to full bathroom, 3 bedrooms, half bath and UPDATED kitchen. HARDWOOD FLOORS THROUGHOUT! Tenants may use REAR grass area to grill and treat as sitting area. PLENTY of parking on street in front of the property for guests. ALL newer appliances in this unit along with plenty of closet space. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income, and references. (PICTURES FROM WHEN PREVIOUSLY LISTED).
